pregnancy.title: Pregnancy Journey
pregnancy.heading: What is happening in pregnancy?
pregnancy.content: Your body is changing to accommodate the growth of your pēpi (baby). Here, you can find information on what is happening to your body, how the pēpi grows and is nourished by the placenta, and the different ways your midwife or doctor may check on your pēpi’s health during pregnancy.

ultrasound.title: Ultrasound
ultrasound.heading: What does my ultrasound scan mean?
ultrasound.content:
During pregnancy, your pēpi (baby) will be checked on using ultrasound imaging. This is a safe and widely used tool, that can help your midwife/doctor know that pēpi is healthy.

This page helps you understand what ultrasound is, and the different ways it is used. There is also an interactive tool to help you better understand your ultrasound scan.

complications.title: Pregnancy Complications
complications.content:
Whilst most pregnancies and births progress smoothly, some can be complicated by pregnancy disorders. If you have been told you have a complication in pregnancy you are not alone – pregnancy disorders affect around 6000 pēpi (baby) and their whānau (family) each year in New Zealand (1 in 10 pregnancies).

On these pages, you will find information to help you understand what causes common issues in pregnancy, how your doctor/midwife may check on pēpi, and what this may mean for your pregnancy journey.

clinical.title: Care pathways
clinical.heading: What does pregnancy care look like in Aotearoa NZ?
clinical.content: Clinical care pathways for pregnancy in Aotearoa New Zealand are organised around a pyramid of community-based primary maternity services, supported by secondary and tertiary hospital services, with the woman choosing a Lead Maternity Carer (LMC), usually a midwife, to coordinate her care. Pathways include primary care for low-risk pregnancies, with consultations and referrals to higher-level specialist services for complex cases or emergencies, ensuring equitable access and appropriate care across all stages of pregnancy.
